stemMd: What is (−3) to the fourth power divided by (−3) squared?
explanationMd: Subtract exponents for the same nonzero base: (−3) squared=9. Direct calculation gives 81/9=9 and confirms the positive sign.

distractorRationale.c: Both powers are even and positive.
